flagship.name: RatRig V-Core 4
flagship.verdictLabel: Best-supported self-build kit — AWD CoreXY, 3030 frame rigidity, official documentation and RatRig community backing

discontinued.name: RatRig V-Minion
discontinued.verdictLabel: Discontinued — RatRig no longer supports the V-Minion; no active kit, no documentation updates
discontinued.note: RatRig discontinued the V-Minion due to supply chain issues and limited demand, then released its CAD and STLs publicly and sold remaining toolheads at cost.

subsystems.label: Motion System
subsystems.description: AWD drive belts, MGN15 gantry rails, stock belted Z, GT1.5 anti-VFA upgrade

framePrecisionParts.name: Spannsysteme 3030 Corner Joining Plate
framePrecisionParts.desc: EN AW-7075 CNC-machined corner connection for 3030-profile frames — replaces printed/plastic corners on the V-Core 3 and V-Core 4.

framePrecisionParts.name: Spannsysteme Diagonal Frame Brace
framePrecisionParts.desc: Triangulates corner connections to cut frame racking — directly reduces ringing at higher print speeds on 3030-profile printers.

framePrecisionParts.name: Spannsysteme Aluminum Idler Spacer
framePrecisionParts.desc: Precision-machined 14mm idler spacer — tighter tolerance than printed spacers, reducing belt-path slop and VFA.

framePrecisionParts.name: Spannsysteme Cast Tooling Plate
framePrecisionParts.desc: EN AW-5083 cast aluminum bed plate, 10mm thick, CMM-certified ±0.05mm — 300mm build size only; currently sold out at BRS.

framePrecisionParts.name: Spannsysteme Ergonomic Frame Handle
framePrecisionParts.desc: CNC aluminum carry handle for 2020/3030 extrusion — won't flex or creep like printed handles on an enclosure moved often.
